test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, decide which of the given conclusions can be true. 

**Statements:**

Some mountains are hills. 

Some hills are rocks. 

All rocks are black. 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some blacks are hills. 

II. All hills being mountains is a possibility. 

III. Some rocks are not mountains.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II are true.
